sources.title: Ornith-1.0-9B model card
sources.evidence: Exact model card names the 9B dense Ornith variant, credits DeepReinforce Team, declares MIT, describes agentic coding/self-scaffolding RL, documents native reasoning and structured tool calls, and serves 262144-token context. Its ~9B label is nominal. Reopened October 27 using a direct request after the web reader failed; current and pinned cards retain the nominal 9B dense designation and family-level Gemma 4/Qwen 3.5 post-training description, without a separate active count.

sources.title: Exact Ornith-1.0-9B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; 32 text layers (24 linear_attention and 8 full_attention), dense FFNs, 27-layer vision encoder, max_position_embeddings=262144, distinct image/video tokens, BF16, and untied input/output embeddings.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: All 760 indexed tensor names match the four inspected safetensors headers. total_size=18819627488 equals the header-derived byte count. Its total_parameters=1469680 is inconsistent with both tensor shapes and byte count and is rejected. Fresh October 27 current index remains at the same 760 tensors and byte total; no shards or headers were downloaded again.

sources.title: Checkpoint shard 1 safetensors header
sources.evidence: Inspected only the 8-byte length plus 4672-byte JSON header using HTTP 206 range requests, without downloading weights. 36 BF16 tensors contain 2471350720 learned elements; all four shards total 9409813744. No quantization scales or persistent buffers were present.

sources.title: Exact multimodal processor configuration
sources.evidence: Checkpoint includes Qwen3VLProcessor, an image processor, and Qwen3VLVideoProcessor with explicit frame sampling (2 fps, 4–768 frames). This is checkpoint-native image/video preprocessing, not merely an agent wrapper.

sources.title: Exact model chat template
sources.evidence: Serializes text, image and video content with native visual tokens; accepts tool schemas, structured tool_calls/tool responses, and reasoning_content; starts thinking by default and supports enable_thinking=false.

sources.title: Original developer release README
sources.evidence: Developer README says it is releasing Ornith-1.0 today, explicitly includes 9B Dense, and documents the exact 9B checkpoint. The June 25 dated commit corroborates the weight release date.

sources.title: Developer release README commit metadata
sources.evidence: Release README commit timestamp is 2026-06-25T05:21:41Z.

sources.title: Exact model repository history
sources.evidence: Commit 4402d8dc236fe9e09d12aeed907a763b66a60533, Add Ornith-1.0-9B model weights, is dated 2026-06-25T06:13:51Z. Earlier June 21–23 commits contain preparatory README/assets; their wording alone does not establish a prior public checkpoint release.

sources.title: Later Ornith-1.5 announcement and comparison tables
sources.evidence: Later first-party table explicitly compares Ornith-1.0-9B on coding, reasoning and agentic tasks. It supplies no separately defined active-parameter count or more precise complete parameter count for Ornith-1.0-9B; sibling 35B-A3B counts are not transferred. Reopened October 27 and inspected all comparison headings: 9B remains a size designation; the explicit 35B-A3B sibling count does not define a dense activation convention.

sources.title: Transformers Qwen3.5 implementation matching checkpoint version
sources.evidence: GatedDeltaNet implementation declares dt_bias and A_log as nn.Parameter, so those checkpoint tensors are learned parameters. Rotary inv_freq/original_inv_freq are nonpersistent buffers and absent from the inspected checkpoint. Dense text projections, norms, untied LM head and vision module weights/biases are learned tensors.

sources.title: Current exact checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 metadata identifies unchanged revision 83dc1f5e24ef8527af019a6b3bf66ac0f1c2c999. The BF16 element aggregate is 9,409,813,744, corroborating the prior learned-tensor census; the separate total=1,469,680 repeats the erroneous index field and is rejected. No exact base_model is declared.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the full original Qwen card and its comparison headings. Under Language Model it specifies Number of Parameters: 9B, with the dense hybrid architecture; it does not separately label 9B active or activated. This language-model total is not an active count and cannot fill Ornith’s active field through lineage.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B Base model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the named pretraining-base candidate. It gives 9B language-model parameters and no separate active count. Neither the base card nor Ornith’s post-training relationship supplies an activation convention to inherit.

sources.title: Later Qwen3.6 model card and comparisons
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the full later first-party card and comparison tables. The explicitly activated 3B specification belongs to its 35B MoE; it supplies no active-count specification for Qwen3.5-9B or Ornith 9B.

sources.title: Later Qwen3.8 model card and comparisons
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the full later first-party card and comparison headings found no Qwen3.5-9B active-parameter disclosure. Its own 27B language-model count is not a transferable activation convention.

sources.title: Ornith 1.0 developer announcement
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Names the 9B dense member and says the family is built on pretrained Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5 with self-scaffolding reinforcement learning. The 9B comparison contains benchmark scores without an active-parameter row or column.

sources.title: Unofficial Ornith VRAM guide
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model search found a table claiming 9B Active Params/Token. The page footer explicitly identifies the site as independent, unofficial and unaffiliated with DeepReinforce AI. The table provides no developer count citation or exact-model activation derivation; the claim is recorded as an unsupported lead.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B provider specifications
sources.evidence: Fresh search found and reopened a provider field claiming 9B activated parameters for Qwen3.5-9B. The linked Qwen card states only the language-model parameter total, without this activation label or a field-level counting definition. The provider claim does not establish an Ornith active count.

developer.note: Original author attribution is DeepReinforce Team; current first-party URLs redirect to the renamed Ornith organization.

family.note: Exact model is identified as part of the Ornith-1.0 family.

release_date.note: June 25 developer release README plus exact checkpoint first weight commit. Earlier README/assets timestamps are preparation evidence, not a demonstrated earlier public weight release.

open_weights.note: Publicly accessible full BF16 checkpoint index and all four shard headers were retrieved without authentication.

license.note: Exact model card and original developer announcement explicitly declare MIT licensing.

parameters_b.note: Complete published checkpoint count: 9409813744 learned parameters from 760 BF16 tensor shapes. Text model plus untied head totals 8953803264; vision encoder/projector totals 456010480. Nominal 9B refers to the size class. No packed quantized tensors/scales/buffers or duplicate tied head were counted; no MTP tensors occur in the index. Ignore erroneous index total_parameters=1469680; total_size corroborates the complete count. Fresh October 27 exact card, unchanged revision and index/metadata corroborate this prior count; retained without a repeat census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/lineage searches and original/later developer comparisons found no separate active count for Ornith 9B or its Qwen3.5 9B base candidate. Qwen’s 9B is explicitly a language-model total; neither dense architecture nor post-training lineage turns it into active parameters. Unofficial Ornith.site and provider SiliconFlow active-count claims lack a developer counting convention. The full multimodal checkpoint total is not copied into this field.

architecture.note: Dense Qwen3.5 hybrid architecture: 24 GatedDeltaNet linear-attention layers alternating with 8 full-attention Transformer layers, dense FFNs, and a 27-layer vision encoder. Dense describes expert structure, not a claim that every layer uses full attention.

context_window.note: Exact max_position_embeddings and both developer serving recipes agree on 262144 tokens. Benchmark footnote mentioning 400K does not establish a larger native context.

modalities.note: Add video: exact checkpoint has visual weights, image/video token IDs, image/video processors, and native image/video chat serialization. This establishes checkpoint input support, not a guarantee that every hosted coding endpoint enables it.

reasoning.note: Exact model card explicitly identifies reasoning output; native template implements think blocks and enable_thinking control.

tool_call.note: Exact model card describes emitted function calls; checkpoint template serializes tool schemas, XML function/parameter calls and tool responses.

description.value: Open dense Qwen3.5-based reasoning model trained with self-scaffolding reinforcement learning for agentic coding.
description.note: Makes the dense architecture and training-based meaning of self-improvement concrete; avoids implying automatic ongoing inference-time learning.

patch.description: Open dense Qwen3.5-based reasoning model trained with self-scaffolding reinforcement learning for agentic coding.
patch.notes: The complete checkpoint contains 9.409813744B learned parameters: 8.953803264B text model and untied head, plus 0.456010480B vision encoder/projector. Its index total_parameters field is erroneous; tensor shapes and total_size support the retained count. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. The dense Qwen3.5 hybrid has 24 linear-attention and 8 full-attention layers. Native inputs include text, images and video; hosted endpoints may expose fewer. June 25, 2026 is the documented weight release. Distribution migrated from deepreinforce-ai to ornith-ai.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained the prior exact 9.409813744B complete total and component breakdown. Fresh exact-model searches, reopened card/index/metadata, original and later Ornith comparisons, and Qwen 3.5 base plus later Qwen cards found no supported active-count convention. Documented unofficial and provider 9B-active leads without promoting them to developer specifications. Added explicit parameter patches and preserved unrelated assessments; no weight shards or repeat census requested.
